senses.gloss: (cmp. אָרַס) to connect, intertwine, braid &c.—Denom. עָרִיס, עֲרִיסָה, עֶרֶס &c.

units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 4:7">Kil. IV, 7</cite> <he>אם עֵרְסָן מלמעלה</he> if he connected them (the two rows of vines) above so as to form an arbor.

senses.gloss: (denom. of עֲרִיסָה) to start dough, contrad. to לוש. Y. Pes. III, 30ᵃ; Y. Bets. I, 60ᵈ top ע׳ לא אמר אלא לש וכ׳ the Boraitha does not say, ‘if one started dough’, but, ‘if one kneaded’; but if one started (on the eve of a Holy Day), this prohibition does not apply.—In gen. to knead, work in (cmp. עָרַךְ).
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 37b:8">Ber. 37ᵇ</cite> <he>בשעֵרְסָנ</he> when he worked the crumbs again into a compact mass; <cite ref="Menachot 75b:9">Men. 75ᵇ</cite> <he>בשעירסן</he>. Y. Ḥall. I, 57ᵇ, v. <cite ref="P01039"><he>עָסוּת</he></cite>.—Part. pass. <he>מְעוֹרָס</he>.

<cite ref="Yoma 2a">Ib.</cite> <he>וההן נשוך לאו כמע׳ הוא</he> (not <he>כמעירס</he>) and that lump of dough made by pressing several pieces together (v. <cite ref="N01325"><he>נָשַׁךְ</he></cite>),—is that not the same as if worked together?

<cite ref="Sifrei Bamidbar 110:2">Sifré Num. 110</cite> (ref. to <he>ערסתכם</he>, <cite ref="Numbers 15:20">Num. XV, 20</cite>, sq.) <he>משיִתְעָרֵס</he> (it is subject to Ḥallah) from the time it has become a compact mass; Yalk. ib. 748 <he>משתֵּעָרֵס</he>.
